read.product: Rated above its décor and candle sub-categories (4.03 vs 3.94). About 15% of buyers report a problem, mostly short burn time and candles that don't float.
read.fulfilment: 69% negative seller feedback, nearly 6 times the décor median of 12%.
read.verdict: Not met at 33.3. The product holds up against the category; the seller account does not.
